fields.summary_ko.0: MediaTek Inc (TW:2454) recorded Q3 revenue of TWD 16.81 billion (approximately $516 million, up 18.3% year-over-year) and net income of TWD 2.82 billion (up 10.8% year-over-year), with stock price on Monday at TWD 4,005, up 2.3%.
fields.summary_ko.1: CEO Rick Tsai stated that AI demand will continue to grow; first-generation AI accelerator initial shipment is expected to generate $2.5 billion revenue in Q4, and second-generation AI accelerator is scheduled for mass production in Q1 2028.
